summary.en: Returning from a mountain hike, Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are blocked by a heavy thunderstorm in the waiting room of Ofumoto train station, in a campaign of Tochigi Prefecture, with other people. All trains arriving and departing for Tokyo were suspended until the end of the storm. After being with Conan at the spa of the station, Kogoro finds in his jacket pocket a ticket containing a request for help and the prediction of a murder. A few hours later, Noriko Kurusu, an assemblyman's secretary, suddenly decides to leave the building and is killed. Masako Ueno, the station employee, is also stunned. Location: Ofumoto Station, Tochigi Prefecture Victim: Noriko Kurusu Cause of death: Gunshot wound Suspects: Yuichi Hokari, Kikuo Inagaki, Masako Ueno, Hitoshi Takegami, Carl Morris, and Fune Shimao She was shot dead after she leaved the cafeteria. Location: Ofumoto Station, Tochigi Prefecture Injury: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Yuichi Hokari, Kikuo Inagaki, Hitoshi Takegami, Carl Morris, and Fune Shimao She was bludgeoned when the lights are out due to lightning. Kogoro and Conan found a note in her hand.
